sentence: This project tests whether the level of the breast cancer biomarker Kaiso predicts survival and how it links to the tumor microenvironment.
This project studies the brainstem and how it connects to whole-brain networks in autistic children.
This project estimates the health burden of heat in New Orleans and finds which neighborhood traits and behavior patterns raise vulnerability to heat.
This project tries to fix the DNA repeat that causes Huntington Disease using base editing and prime editing, and tests delivery in mice.
This project studies how a molecule linked to Alzheimer's disease disrupts glucose metabolism and mitochondrial respiration in the brain.
This project studies how astrocytes sense flow and pressure around blood vessels in the brain, and how this changes vessel width and fluid flow.
This project tries to find out how mutations in two genes drive meningioma, a type of brain tumor.
This project studies how the hippocampus and the cortex work together to form lasting memories, and how aging and Alzheimer's disease disrupt this.
This project builds AI models that use several kinds of data to predict neurocognitive decline in people with HIV.
This project studies how neuroactive steroids such as allopregnanolone relate to alcohol use disorder and to successful treatment.
This project studies how chemotherapy for childhood lymphoma harms skeletal muscle growth, and whether boosting muscle stem cells can prevent that harm.
This project uses causal machine learning to study whether e-cigarette use leads to later combustible cigarette smoking among youth and adults.
This project studies how inflammation changes the function of myelinating oligodendrocytes in multiple sclerosis, using stem cell and genomic technologies.
This project tests cerebellar stimulation that prevents seizures and a way of probing the brain to forecast seizure risk.
This project studies how gene silencing enzymes work on chromatin and develops chemicals that block or boost one of them.
This project tries to find out how the immune system stops mutated stem cells from taking over the colon.
This project tests a cell therapy for glioblastoma that targets tumor cells and blocks the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment.
